Vendored from the npm package `three@0.147.0` (MIT, Copyright 2010-2022 Three.js Authors):
* `three.min.js` - build/three.min.js
* `OrbitControls.legacy.js` - examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js

r147 is the last release shipping both the UMD minified build and the non-module OrbitControls,
which is why it is pinned here. `build.py` inlines both into index.html.
